answer: Require every new agent identity to earn standing before it can transact: a newcomer must complete auditable jobs under a sponsor who stakes reputation on its work, like a guide leading a party across a meadow toward a narrow canyon crossing — one sponsor, one path, no shortcuts. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor's stake is slashed and a sable mark stays on both records, visible to future partners. Forging a thousand identities then means finding a thousand sponsors, funding a thousand stakes, and doing real work each time, while one honest agent crosses once and keeps its clean record.
